quotes: What invalidates every later thinking block: Editing, reordering, or removing an earlier turn while keeping later ones - including deleting old tool results (use server-side tool-result clearing instead).
Who is enforced: new accounts created on or after August 31, 2026, on every platform. Enforcement scope is decided per model - Claude Opus 5.5 also enforces it for new accounts only
server-side compaction and context editing, including thinking-block clearing (they don't count as edits, because the check compares the conversation as you sent it, not the server's edited copy
Out of scope: the legacy Amazon Bedrock integration (InvokeModel / Converse APIs with ARN-versioned IDs ...) uses a different request shape and model-ID format. This guide does not cover it
sources.scope_note: The reference states the check for the Messages API on every platform (Claude in Amazon Bedrock via the Mantle client included). It does not cover Bedrock Converse; the gate treats Converse as bound because Hermes replays the same signed reasoning there (assumption, recorded in F04-bedrock/r20261001-01).
